title: 第13章 百姓安居乐业！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我的娘啊。”胡阿三没好气道，“别说能多活数月了，就算只能多活半月，谁还会顾得了那么多？”

要不是几个月前，他娘子意外有了身孕，他现在说不定也要失踪了。

“我不是你娘！”凝香不满瞪眼，又道，“这么多人无故失踪，此地的衙门就不管……”

张宁揉了揉她的脑袋，打断道：“又何不食肉糜了不是？这里是荒山县，不是皇城，皇城那套，在这里行不通的。”

但他的语气里，并没有责怪的意味。

这不能怪凝香天真。

事实上，在看到衙门外的树皮，被扒光之前，连他自己都对史书上“大饥，人相食”、“屠城”等字眼，没有真正的概念。

唯有真正亲眼目睹，才知道这短短几个字，描述的是何种地狱。

凝香虽然是奴婢出身，但皇城里的奴婢，和这里地方豪强家的下人，也是一个天，一个地。

“衙门？”胡阿三更是嗤笑出声，“你以为那些狗官是大人？他们才懒得管我们这些贱民的死活呢。”

张宁没理会胡阿三的马屁，而是问道：“钱家这种情况，持续了这么久，可有什么风言风语传出来？”

“有传闻说，那些仆人都是没伺候好钱世康那畜生，被钱世康打死后，被人扔到山上曝尸荒野，喂野狗了。”

钱世康那泌阳的，还有这种本事？

张宁有些怀疑。

可还不待他质疑，胡阿三却又道：“但大人，小人却觉得，这些风言风语不甚可信，钱世康那畜生，应该没胆子杀人。”

“他都欺辱你怀有身孕的娘子了，你怎么还替他说话？”凝香不满道。

胡阿三正色道：“正因此，我才会这么说，当时那畜生，被我发现的时候，吓得直接就跪地求饶了，这样一个废物，又怎么敢杀人呢？”

钱家的水，比我想象得还要更深啊。

“行，本官会多加小心的，此事本官也会暗中调查。”张宁道，“快回去照顾你娘子吧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"My mother," Hu Asan said angrily, "Let alone a few more months to live, even if you can only live for half a month, who would care so much?"

If it hadn't been for his wife's unexpected pregnancy a few months ago, he might have disappeared now.

"I'm not your mother!" Ningxiang glared dissatisfied and said, "So many people have disappeared for no reason, and the government here doesn't care..."

Zhang Ning rubbed her head and interrupted: "Why don't you eat minced meat? This is Huangshan County, not the Imperial City. The Imperial City approach won't work here."

But there was no blame in his tone.

This can't be blamed on Ningxiang's naivety.

In fact, before he saw the tree bark outside the yamen being stripped naked, even he had no real idea of ​​the words "great famine, people cannibalism" and "massacre of the city" in the history books.

Only by truly witnessing it with your own eyes can you know what kind of hell these few words describe.

Although Ningxiang was born as a slave, the slaves in the imperial city and the servants of the powerful local families here are also in the same world.

"Yamen?" Hu Asan even sneered, "Do you think those dog officials are adults? They don't bother to care about the lives of untouchables like us."

Zhang Ning ignored Hu Asan's flattery and asked, "This situation in the Qian family has been going on for so long, but what rumors have come out?"

"There are rumors that those servants were all beasts like Qian Shikang who failed to take good care of him. They were beaten to death by Qian Shikang and then thrown to the mountains to expose their bodies in the wilderness and fed to wild dogs."

Qian Shikang, that Biyang guy, still has this kind of ability?

Zhang Ning was a little skeptical.

But before he could question it, Hu Asan said again: "But adults and villains feel that these rumors are not credible. That beast Qian Shikang should not have the guts to kill anyone."

"He has already insulted your pregnant wife, why do you still speak for him?" Ningxiang said dissatisfied.

Hu Asan said seriously: "That's why I said this. When I discovered that beast, he was so frightened that he knelt down and begged for mercy. How could such a waste dare to kill someone?"

The water in Qian's house is deeper than I thought.

"Okay, I will be more careful, and I will also investigate this matter secretly." Zhang Ning said, "Go back and take care of your wife."
